historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and denied the permit to demolish a structure at 4367 25th Street.

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works and granted the permit to alter the building at 4367 - 25th Street, allowing the downstairs bathroom on the condition that the ground floor door be completely sealed.
